messages:
ruth: quick heads-up  i opened a PR that introduces a "slim" card variant for dense dashboards. scoped tokens only (`--space-slim-02`, `--card-gutter-slim`). on staging the primary action on a few cards looks visually low and stacked toasts land on top of compact headers. screenshots + Percy link in PR: https://staging.redwood.dev/slim-cards/shot.png

kai: can you paste the token snippet here and confirm scope? want to avoid unintended list/table regressions.

ruth: token diff (scoped):
```diff
+ --space-slim-02: 8px; /* new scoped */
+ --card-gutter-slim: 12px;
```
I tried to limit the import to `.Card--slim` but i missed one selector in the card-actions import.

omar: small change but the visual baseline issue is likely that `.card-actions` isn't vertically centered in the slim variant. quick patch: `.Card--slim .card-actions { display:flex; align-items:center; gap: var(--space-slim-02); }` That should fix the button baseline.

hema: toast overlap analysis: toasts are currently positioned inside the main DOM flow using absolute offsets from the top of the app shell. when compact cards shorten the header area, toasts collide. propose a top-right portal with a header-safe offset and stack math handled in JS. sketch:
```css
.toast-portal { position: fixed; top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + var(--header-offset, 0px) + 10px); right: 16px; z-index: 14000; }
.toast { will-change: transform; }
```
compute y offsets in JS on mount and on header dimension changes. avoid layout thrash by using rAF and debounced resize handlers.

kai: top-right portal ok but a few pages have sticky top filters that change height. use a ResizeObserver on the header node to recompute portal `top` instead of polling. also check pages with a floating composer (chat) that might overlap the portal.

ruth: accessibility note: each toast currently has its own `aria-live="polite"` which causes multiple rapid announcements when several toasts fire. proposal: single live region inside the portal with `role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false"` and programmatically update only the latest toast text (visually-hidden) so the screen reader announces just the newest notification. persistent toasts should include `aria-describedby` linking to the live region ID.

omar: +1. keyboard expectations: ESC closes modals but not toasts today. i expect ESC to dismiss ephemeral toasts when focus isn't inside a focus trap. add `if (!document.activeElement.closest('.focus-trap')) dismissEphemeralToasts()` and include e2e a11y tests for NVDA/VoiceOver.

hema: perf caveat: avoid doing `calc()` with CSS variables per toast on every stack update and avoid reading `offsetHeight` in a tight loop. compute final translateY values in JS once (on mount and on resize debounced), set inline `transform` and rely on `will-change: transform`.

kai: another visual nit: the slimmer tokens reduce hit target around icon-only actions in `.card-actions`. touch targets should remain 40px min. add a small helper: `.icon-button { min-inline-size: 40px; min-block-size: 40px; }` when `Card--slim` is active.

ruth: plan: 1) i'll patch the card-actions selector and revert the accidental import so only `.Card--slim` uses the scoped tokens; 2) hema implement a top-right toast portal with header RO + stack math; 3) omar add live-region behavior + ESC handling + tests; 4) kai add touch-target safeguard and QA Percy checklist for CTA baseline and table rows. target: PRs by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

design-bot: PR #7710 (slim card tokens) assigned to ruth  status: needs review.

omar: once the revert + portal PRs land let's run the visual diffs across top console pages and then gate `.Card--slim` behind `feature.ui.slimCards` for canary rollout. also add an a11y smoke test in CI that verifies only one live-region announcement per toast burst.

ruth: sounds good  i'll open the revert now and attach updated Percy snapshots. thanks everyone for the rapid review.
